lines.text: An angel tells Philip to go to the chariot, and Philip runs up and hears the man reading Isaiah.

problems.problem: Its true detail "asks whether he understands what he is reading" isn't in Acts 8:30 word for word.
Its wrong detail "asks where he got the scroll" is 6 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
